uharfbuzz 0.57.0 and bundled HarfBuzz 15.0.0

The Python binding is distributed under Apache License 2.0; LICENSE retains the exact upstream text. The bundled HarfBuzz native engine uses the original terms and copyright notices in harfbuzz-COPYING (Old MIT). Both are retained separately; the binding licence alone does not replace the native engine notice.

Immutable upstream commits, release artifact SHA256 values and original notice origins are recorded in provenance.json. CaseOps has not modified either library. The application font-loading adapter is separate application code. No font or shaping library is acquired from a network at PDF-render time. Public notice copies do not add these API dependencies to the JavaScript dependency registry.
